title: Regular Diet After Colorectal Surgery
official: Impact of Postoperative Regular Diet on Colorectal Outcomes and Patient Quality of Life
summary: The goal of this pilot study is to assess the safety and feasibility of regular diet after surgical removal of the colon. The study will enroll patients preoperatively, prior to colon surgery, and will follow participants for up to 30 days. The study hypothesizes that simplifying nutritional recommendations is safe and may improve quality of life.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female ≥ 18 years of age
* Scheduled to undergo colorectal resection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with bowel obstructions
* Patients below the age of 18
sponsor: Weill Medical College of Cornell University
